primary_reader: Agency owner or operations lead at a 5–20-person agency
situation: They leave client calls with assigned next steps and must turn the transcript into a clear first follow-up.
job_to_be_done: Prepare a usable follow-up draft that preserves the named owner and date without spending the median 18 minutes shown in the synthetic manual condition.
felt_problem: The follow-up is slow to draft and assigned details can disappear between the call and the first email.
awareness: Problem aware; tool-category aware; not assumed to know RelayNote.
placement: Problem-aware B2B demo-page opening with unknown prior trust.
voice_rule: Use the frozen tone only. Do not imitate Kyle, Matthew, a founder, or an unstated brand voice.
forbidden_assumptions: The reader has lost revenue because of follow-up omissions.
The reader currently uses a particular CRM or meeting platform.
The agency is a RelayNote customer.
The synthetic test represents the market.
